title: token_record.v1
description: One record per model call made inside a factory run (03_InfrastructureZone/05_Cost.md §5; 06_AgentZone/01_Agent_Standards.md §7 Budgets). Emitted by the shared telemetry package so every agent logs the same shape, and ingested by the cost ledger. The record carries token counts, never a cost: spend is computed by the ledger from these counts and a versioned price table. run_id plus call_id is the ledger's idempotency key, so a resent record changes nothing.

run_id.description: The orchestrator run that made the call.

ticket_key.description: The board ticket the run works, e.g. KAN-18.

attempt.description: Attempt within the ticket or finding: fixers stop at 3, review rounds at 4.

model_id.description: The exact model ID the call used.

provider.description: The route the call took; the price table is keyed by provider and model.

prompt_tokens.description: Input tokens not served from cache.
